message:
Let me look at the fuzzer build setup and understand how the fuzzer is built. Let me also check if there's a pre-built binary:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -name "ip6-send-fuzzer" -o -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---" && cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libfuzzer/build.sh</｜｜DSML｜｜>
